svg.title: Basic lighting: diffuse and specular reflection
svg.desc: Detailed generated crate illustrations above coordinate-constructed SVG diagrams. Ambient plus diffuse plus specular forms the final color. Incoming and reflected rays are symmetric about the normal. View direction is separate from reflected direction.

g.text: Equal angles are measured from N. The highlight strengthens as V aligns with R.
Theory illustration • qualitative crate lighting • precise SVG vectors • not an engine screenshot
